title: CRDT property test: convergence after arbitrary partition
description:
Write a proptest that simulates: two nodes diverge (each appends N arbitrary entries), then run mutual reconcile+backfill until convergence. Assert final tip sets are identical. N is proptest-generated (1 to 100). Artifact: crates/core/tests/crdt_properties.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Convergence reached for all generated N
- Max reconcile rounds bounded (log(N) expected)
- Any non-convergence is P0
